defs.def:constructive-repair-handle: For positive-law repair, start from Bauer--Fike localization of the empirical compressed operator, replace individual eigenvectors inside overlapping discs by Kato contour projectors, transport aggregate projector mass only across each cluster diameter, and project the finite summary onto the positive \(k\)-atomic moment cone before extracting a real probability measure. For the labeled-weight converse, differentiate the Bernoulli factorization of \(P_{\varepsilon}^{\mathrm{wit}}\) and solve the linear score-cancellation equations for proxy and treatment primitives so that a weight displacement \(h\) preserves the factorization while the observed score has order \(g h\).

prose_overlay.tldr: On a uniformly conditioned causal VMW submodel, the primary theorem is a gap-free Lipschitz modulus from the observable moment summary to the positive quotient latent-effect law in \(W_1\), uniform through simultaneous effect merges and splits. Root-\(n\) estimation, honest root-\(n\)-diameter confidence sets, and a cluster report with explicit true-cluster association follow from that modulus. Same-class minimax corollaries give root-\(n\) quotient-law risk and effect-ordered weight risk \(\min\{1,(\sqrt n\,\delta)^{-1}\}\), using factorization-preserving pairs on an explicit full-rank unequal-weight two-class witness. Each converse also transfers to any published-VMW comparator class containing its exact two-point witness pair; no containment of an entire local neighborhood is required. The quotient collision point belongs to the published structural/finite-regularity model but lies outside the separated Theorem 7.2 recovery class, whereas the labeled pair is separated. The modulus, estimator uppers, confidence and cluster guarantees, and matching-minimax conclusions remain restricted to the stated uniformly conditioned classes.
prose_overlay.related_work: Virk, Mazaheri, and Wu (2026, Theorem 5.4, Proposition 6.2, Section 7.1, and Theorem 7.2) provide the population operator-moment identity, the known homogeneity reduction, bounded observable-moment conditions, support localization, and separated inverse-eigengap weight recovery. Their structural/finite-regularity model contains the explicit quotient collision pair because it retains full proxy rank and strict positivity without requiring distinct effects, but the collision point is outside the separated simple-effect recovery class of Theorem 7.2; the labeled witness pair is separated. Consequently, the two Le Cam converses transfer to any published-VMW comparator class containing the corresponding exact pair, with no need for whole-neighborhood containment. The gap-free positive-law modulus, estimator uppers, confidence and cluster guarantees, and matching-minimax conclusions remain on the explicitly narrower uniformly conditioned causal submodel. Mazaheri, Squires, and Uhler (2025) identify a finite latent-effect mixture through scalar synthetic moments and a Hankel pencil, without collision-uniform inference. Bauer and Fike (1960) localize spectra of perturbed diagonalizable operators, while Kato (1995, Chapter II) supplies contour-defined aggregate projectors for externally isolated clusters; neither result assigns positive causal spectral masses through a merge. Wu and Yang (2020, Sections 1, 4, and 5) project noisy summaries onto a feasible moment space before positive atomic extraction in Gaussian mixture deconvolution and inform the repair handle. Heinrich and Kahn (2018, Sections 3--5) and Ho and Nguyen (2016) analyze collision singularities for ordinary mixtures, not factorization-preserving pairs in the VMW observed proxy experiment. Deo and Randrianarisoa (2023), Robins and van der Vaart (2006), and Bing, Bunea, and Niles-Weed (2025) inform the confidence-set architecture but do not treat multiplicity of a nonnormal causal operator. Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2018) motivate proxy conditional-independence and rank discipline. Van Amsterdam et al. (2022) provide the PROTECT stage-III NSCLC consumer, conditional on a separate finite-fitness and censoring bridge; their hazard model is not claimed to lie in \(\mathcal M\). Brown and Purves (1973) supply the measurable-extrema selection theorem used to choose a Borel nearest point in the compact feasible-summary closure.
prose_overlay.interpretation: The regular inferential object is the quotient law, not an effect-ordered labeling of latent classes. When effects collide, the lattice estimator and Wasserstein confidence sets continue to operate at root-\(n\) scale. The cluster report merges coordinates unresolved at radius \(R_{n,\alpha}/m_\star\) and reports their aggregate mass; only externally separated clusters receive sharper coordinate interpretation. The theoretical image set and computable outer set are both honest but are not asserted equal or nested.
prose_overlay.technical_internal_limitation: The analytic collision bottleneck is settled by the gap-free positive-measure modulus, including simultaneous merges and splits and nonreal raw empirical spectra after feasible-summary projection. The explicit factorization-preserving calculations also settle the two local lower-bound orders. The remaining open issue is computational rather than statistical: nearest projection and exact inversion of the continuum feasible-summary set may be expensive, and \(\mathrm{oeq:constructive\text{-}total\text{-}repair}\) asks whether the original sharp summary-inversion image can be computed exactly in polynomial time in the fixed-dimensional exact-real model. The finite-library net estimator supplies a polynomial-time root-\(n\) law estimator, but does not by itself compute that exact sharp image.
prose_overlay.honest_scope: The law-level theorems fix and know \(k,d_x,d_z\), use the exact VMW observable conditional independences, and impose two explicitly new uniform-conditioning conditions: a lower bound on every joint latent-arm probability and singular-value margins for \(A_0,A_1,B\). These conditions imply \(P(T=t)\ge k\pi_0\) and, under the conditional normalization of \(M_t(P)\), \(\sigma_k(M_t(P))\ge\pi_0\sigma_0^2\); the converse inclusion and gap-free resolution of the full VMW class are not claimed. The displayed potential-outcome and effect envelopes are derived from the retained proxy rank, observable envelopes, separation, consistency, armwise ignorability, and latent--arm positivity conditions; no separate compact-support assumption is imposed. The two-sided \(g\)-window is an additional local-regime shell used only for labeled weights. Population identification and the homogeneous identities \(\Delta Q(P)=\tau_\star I_k\) and \(\nu_P=\delta_{\tau_\star}\) are published VMW background. Each lower bound transfers to any published-VMW comparator class containing its exact two-point witness pair, but no whole-neighborhood containment is required and no gap-free modulus, estimator upper, confidence, cluster, or matching-minimax result transfers with it. The quotient collision point is in the published structural/finite-regularity model but outside the separated Theorem 7.2 recovery class; the labeled pair is separated. Recovery of latent labels at equality, unknown \(k\), and exact polynomial-time computation of the sharp summary-inversion image remain outside the settled scope. PROTECT remains a conditional consumer until a separate theorem maps a prespecified finite fitness stratification and bounded censoring-adjusted outcome into the VMW moment model.

project_justification.gap: Virk, Mazaheri, and Wu identify the operator moments and analyze separated eigenpair recovery, but do not give collision-uniform positive-law estimation or an evaluable confidence/report construction when empirical eigenvalues may be nonreal.
project_justification.niche: The regular causal object is the quotient probability law that aggregates mass at equal effects. Effect-ordered weights remain irregular near a collision, while transport over an unresolved cluster can still be root-\(n\).
project_justification.fill: The paper makes the positive-measure \(W_1\) modulus the root theorem on a uniformly conditioned causal VMW submodel, derives total root-\(n\) estimation, honest root-\(n\)-diameter sets and well-posed cluster reports, and calibrates same-class quotient-law and labeled-weight minimax risk using observed-Kullback--Leibler pairs that preserve the proxy factorization.  The lower bounds transfer further to precisely those published-VMW comparator classes containing the corresponding two witness laws; whole-neighborhood containment is unnecessary, while all upper and inference guarantees retain their narrower class scope.

prop:observed-vmw-margin-inclusion.justification: This proposition derives the exact arm, compressed, stacked, and observable bounds and proves the uniform potential-outcome and effect envelope from retained hypotheses.
prop:observed-vmw-margin-inclusion.gap: VMW uses qualitative rank and positivity.  The present class strengthens those two conditions quantitatively; no extra latent conditional-moment or potential-outcome support condition is imposed.
prop:observed-vmw-margin-inclusion.consumer: The derived envelope supplies the common law support for every estimator and inference result while preserving the one-way subclass and lower-bound-transfer boundaries.

thm:collision-uniform-root-n.justification: The theorem gives the same collision-uniform root-\(n\) law rate for the explicit lattice estimator and the retained theoretical estimator.
thm:collision-uniform-root-n.gap: Published VMW separated recovery does not give either this gap-free quotient-law guarantee or a total positive-real rule on arbitrary empirical summaries.
thm:collision-uniform-root-n.consumer: Conditional on a separate censoring and prespecified finite-fitness bridge, the explicit estimator could support stable heterogeneity summaries for the 504-patient stage-III NSCLC PROTECT setting; the theorem does not validate that bridge.

prop:same-class-quotient-minimax.justification: This corollary states the root-\(n\) minimax frontier on the explicit uniformly conditioned subclass containing the local quotient experiment.
prop:same-class-quotient-minimax.gap: VMW does not state collision-uniform quotient-law minimax risk; only the converse, not the achievability result, transfers to larger published-VMW classes containing the path.
prop:same-class-quotient-minimax.consumer: The result calibrates the smallest uniform Wasserstein accuracy on the displayed subclass without overstating full-class scope.

prop:polynomial-net-law-estimator.justification: The no-advice structured lattice now enforces a fixed atom floor while preserving deterministic and high-probability root-\(n\) error and polynomial candidate count in fixed dimension.
prop:polynomial-net-law-estimator.gap: It supplies explicit positive-real law estimation and the center for computable inference, but does not compute the original summary-inversion image.
prop:polynomial-net-law-estimator.consumer: The estimator centers the computable outer confidence set and cluster report.

thm:polynomial-net-law-estimator.justification: The finite-library estimator attains the same collision-uniform rate with online polynomial operation count when class-dependent admissible-summary representatives are precomputed.
thm:polynomial-net-law-estimator.gap: The finite-library search exposes polynomial online computation at the modulus scale, but its representative library is class-dependent precomputed advice and is not supplied by the data alone.
thm:polynomial-net-law-estimator.consumer: It provides an advised computational alternative and does not claim exact computation of the full confidence or cluster report.

oeq:constructive-total-repair.justification: Only exact or sharp computation of the original summary-inversion image and its exact extrema remains open.
oeq:constructive-total-repair.gap: The explicit outer confidence set and report do not provide a finite representation of the admissible-summary closure or black-box extension image.
oeq:constructive-total-repair.consumer: A solution would sharpen computation of the original theoretical object, not supply the already-available evaluable outer report.

thm:published-vmw-converse-transfer.justification: This records the maximal converse scope justified by exact witness-pair containment, without imposing containment of either full local neighborhood.
thm:published-vmw-converse-transfer.gap: The subclass upper bounds do not transfer upward, but each minimax converse transfers to every published-VMW comparator class containing its exact two-point witness pair.
thm:published-vmw-converse-transfer.consumer: The theorem tells analysts exactly which two laws a larger comparator class must contain for the converse, while preventing that transfer from being mistaken for an upper or confidence guarantee.

thm:honest-root-n-confidence.justification: The theorem simultaneously covers the retained theoretical image and an evaluable atom-floor outer set, with root-\(n\) Wasserstein diameters.
thm:honest-root-n-confidence.gap: The two honest sets serve different purposes and are not claimed equal or nested.
thm:honest-root-n-confidence.consumer: The outer set supports sample-evaluable aggregate latent-effect-law reporting without preliminary separation.

thm:cluster-adaptive-report.justification: The explicit outer set yields a constrained-program report whose support and aggregate-mass errors adapt to the external cluster gap.
thm:cluster-adaptive-report.gap: The report is evaluable in fixed dimension, but an efficient exact solver and exact extrema for the original theoretical image remain outside the claim.
thm:cluster-adaptive-report.consumer: Analysts can pool effects unresolved at the confidence radius and report separate cluster masses only when the external gap supports them.

sampling_model.design: Independent sampling from the uniformly conditioned causal fixed-\(k\) VMW submodel with no separately assumed latent outcome-moment envelope.
sampling_model.units: \(O_i=(T_i,X_i,Z_i,Y_i)\), for \(i=1,\ldots,n\), are independent with common observed law \(P_O\).
sampling_model.treatment: Treatment is binary, and every joint latent-class and treatment-arm probability is at least \(\pi_0\).
sampling_model.overlap: Every joint latent-class and treatment-arm probability is at least \(\pi_0\), and \(A_0,A_1,B\) have smallest singular value at least \(\sigma_0\).  No treatment-effect eigengap is imposed for law-level results; the \(g\)-window is used only for labeled coordinates.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The published VMW boundedness conditions are imposed separately on \(X\), \(ZX^\top\), and \(YZX^\top\). Armwise empirical moments divide by \(\max\{1,N_{t,n}\}\), are zero on empty arms, and combine with \(n^{-1}\sum_iX_i\) to form \(\widehat S_n\). The theoretical route applies Borel nearest-summary projection and \(\overline F\); the computable route minimizes an explicit no-advice finite structured lattice and never diagonalizes the raw empirical operator.
